title: Nvidia invests $2B in CoreWeave stock

sources.quote: In addition, NVIDIA has invested $2 billion in CoreWeave Class A common stock at a purchase price of $87.20 per share.

explain: Nvidia bought $2 billion of new CoreWeave shares at $87.20 each. CoreWeave spends heavily on Nvidia chips, so part of this money can cycle back to Nvidia as GPU purchases.
